mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user_ref ( user_id, username, real_name, status, dept_id, dept_name, sync_time, source_version, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{username}, #{realName}, #{status}, #{deptId}, #{deptName}, #{syncTime}, #{sourceVersion}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE username = VALUES(username), real_name = VALUES(real_name), status = VALUES(status), dept_id = VALUES(dept_id), dept_name = VALUES(dept_name), sync_time = VALUES(sync_time), source_version = VALUES(source_version), update_time = VALUES(update_time)
